subject: Request: Subprocessor incident debrief + delegation plan for EdgeSight
messages:
From: Lena Hoffmann <lena.h@finergy.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@finergy.com
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 16:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Request: Subprocessor incident debrief + delegation plan for EdgeSight

Hi Vanessa,

Following up from our security intake team — we saw the temporary addition of a logging/telemetry partner (EdgeSight) to Redwood's processor roster last week. For our DPA and internal audit we need a concise incident debrief and evidence packet that covers the following: 

- Why EdgeSight was added temporarily (root cause / trigger)
- Exact data types processed and whether any plaintext PII left the EU
- Retention window and deletion proof for the affected logs
- Network egress paths (which cloud regions and subprocessor handoffs)
- SOC2 / ISO attestation or compensating controls while EdgeSight was live

Can you send a short debrief and attach any evidence (SOC2 summary, export diagrams, retention logs)? If you have a proposed delegation plan or DPA addendum for a permanent change, include that as well. We need this by EOD Apr 6 to close our audit ticket (FIN-SEC-2026-0317).

Thanks,
Lena
Lena Hoffmann
Sr. Security Analyst, Finergy
Lena.H@finergy.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffmann <lena.h@finergy.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 1 Apr 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Subprocessor incident debrief + delegation plan for EdgeSight

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and the checklist. We're compiling the evidence and a short debrief now. Quick context up front: EdgeSight was engaged as a temporary telemetry sink after an intermittent telemetry ingestion outage in our EU region on 2026-03-28. It was scoped to accept anonymized telemetry and delivery-only logs to speed backlog processing while we patched the ingestion cluster. 

High-level timeline we'll send in the packet:
- 2026-03-28 02:15 UTC: Ingestion cluster OOM and backlog observed (internal incident INC-2026-172).
- 2026-03-28 03:05 UTC: Temporary routing rule applied to forward delivery logs to EdgeSight (limited to non-customer-content telemetry).
- 2026-03-30 21:00 UTC: Ingestion cluster stabilized; forwarding removed; verification completed 2026-03-31.

We'll attach: EdgeSight-SOC2-summary.pdf, subprocessor-snapshot-edgesight-20260401.csv, and the export diagram. Also including retention proof for the affected 72-hour window. If you need us to run a re-check with your team on whether any metadata fields are considered PII for your classification, happy to do that — cc'ing Kimberly (privacy lead) and Marissa (ops) to coordinate evidence.

Expect the full packet by Monday (Apr 5) EOD PDT.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Trust, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Subprocessor incident debrief + delegation plan for EdgeSight

Team — forwarding Finergy's request. Draft debrief attached in Drive (link below). Notes for the packet: 

1) Data scope: we only forwarded 'delivery' telemetry (ingestion timing, queue ids, anonymized host tags). No request/response payloads or user-generated content were forwarded. Fields forwarded: timestamp, queue_id (hashed), status_code, node_region, failure_reason (enum).

2) Pseudonymization: queue_ids were salted+hashed before forwarding. Hash salt stored in our KMS but not sent to EdgeSight.

3) Retention: EdgeSight retention configured to 7 days for that temporary window; we have deletion confirmation logs (see attatched CSV).

4) Egress: EU->EU only (primary edge region eu-west-1). No US or APAC egress for these logs.

5) Controls: EdgeSight provided a SOC2 summary and signed AUP; legal reviewed the temporary Annex. Still need to route a DPA addendum for any permanent roster change — I drafted a short addendum (DocuSign link in packet).

Attachments to prepare: subprocessor-snapshot-edgesight-20260401.csv, edgesight-evidence-bundle.zip (contains deletion logs + access audit), dataflow-egress-diagram.png.

Requesting Kimberly for a quick sign-off on the statement about PII and retention. Marissa — can you confirm the deletion logs and give me the single-file export that shows the deletion timestamp per object?

Drive draft: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/finergy/edgesight-debrief-2026-04-01

—Vanessa

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffmann <lena.h@finergy.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Subprocessor incident debrief + delegation plan for EdgeSight

Hi Lena — thanks for the patience. Please find our debrief below and the evidence bundle attached. If you prefer a short sftp transfer for the logs rather than the ZIP, let us know and we'll arrange it.

Short debrief (summary):
- Trigger: temporary ingestion outage (INC-2026-172) required a short-term failover to EdgeSight for delivery-only telemetry to clear backlog.
- Data types processed: anonymized delivery telemetry (timestamp, hashed_queue_id, status_code, node_region, failure_reason_enum). No request or content payloads were forwarded.
- PII assessment: hashed_queue_id was treated as pseudonymized; based on Finergy's policy threshold we do not consider this plaintext PII. If Finergy would like us to treat it as PII, we will provide an export with additional redaction and confirm deletion.
- Retention & deletion proof: EdgeSight retention set to 7 days for the temporary window. The attached edgesight-evidence-bundle.zip includes deletion confirmations (audit entries) for the affected objects — exported 2026-04-01T22:10:11Z.
- Egress & residency: Processing remained within EU (eu-west-1). No cross-border transfer occurred.
- Controls: SOC2 summary attached; EdgeSight committed to no sub-subprocessing without prior notice.

Next steps / asks:
1) We can provide a DPA addendum for a permanent roster change; we've seeded a short DocuSign addendum: https://docusign.com/link/4f3b2a-edgeproc-dpa-addendum
2) If Finergy classifies hashed_queue_id as PII, tell us and we'll run a redaction pass and supply re-export with deletion confirmation.
3) Confirm if the evidence bundle satisfies FIN-SEC-2026-0317 or if you need additional artifacts (IP allowlist, minimal access roster).

Attachments: edgesight-evidence-bundle.zip (deletion logs, access audit), EdgeSight-SOC2-summary.pdf, dataflow-egress-diagram.png, subprocessor-snapshot-edgesight-20260401.csv

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Privacy & Compliance Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
